title: 933. Validate Stack Sequences

examples.explanation: Push and pop in an order that frees 4, 5, 3, 2, 1.
1 is trapped beneath 2 when it is wanted.

hints: Replay the process: push each value, then pop from the top while it matches the next wanted output.
The sequence is valid exactly when every wanted value gets popped by the end of the replay.
